nu-map/documentation / src/ / ports/ / IPlannerQuery + IPlannerAction

IPlannerQuery + IPlannerAction driving ports — AI inbound

The two driving (primary) ports through which external actors — Claude via MCP, CLI tools, test harnesses — read and mutate the planner. IPlannerQuery is the full read surface: catalog search, plan snapshot, requirement audit, dry-run validation. IPlannerAction is the write surface: propose for user review, apply immediately, or fire UI-only commands. The canonical PlanContext type is defined in IPlannerQuery and shared across both ports and IAIAssistant.

Parent
ports/
Direction
Driving (primary) — external actors call these ports. Contrast with all other ports (driven, app calls adapter).
MCP implementation
src/adapters/mcp/plannerQueryAdapter.js, src/adapters/mcp/plannerActionAdapter.js
PlanContext defined in
IPlannerQuery.js — single canonical definition imported by IAIAssistant and IPlannerAction

Execution modes (IPlannerAction)

Every write goes through one of three methods. Choosing the right one is the key design decision when Claude proposes a change:

MethodWhen to useUser seesUndo?
propose(changeset) Substantive restructuring Claude is suggesting: adding a semester of courses, switching major + updating requirements, building an alternative plan Review UI with rationale and each action listed — user approves or rejects before anything changes N/A — nothing applies until user approves
apply(changeset) Unambiguous single-step actions the user clearly asked for: "move CS3500 to spring", "set my major to CS" Change takes effect immediately, exactly as if the user did it by hand Yes — entire batch pushed as one undo entry (Ctrl+Z reverses all)
command(uiAction) Orienting the user's attention: select a course Claude is discussing, pre-fill the search, switch bank tab UI state changes only (selection, search, tab); no plan data mutation No — no undo entry

Recommended Claude workflow

sequenceDiagram participant CL as Claude participant Q as IPlannerQuery participant A as IPlannerAction CL->>Q: getPlan() — read current state CL->>Q: auditRequirements(programId, plan) — check requirement gaps CL->>Q: validateChangeset(actions) — dry-run proposed changes Note over CL: Reason about result — does it resolve
the gap? Any new violations? alt complex restructuring CL->>A: propose(changeset with rationale) — user reviews else simple unambiguous change CL->>A: apply(changeset) — immediate + undoable end CL->>A: command(FOCUS_COURSE) — orient user's attention
Always dry-run before proposing. validateChangeset() applies the actions to a copy of the plan and returns both violations and the resulting PlanContext — Claude can reason about the outcome before the user sees it.

IPlannerQuery methods

Course catalog

searchCourses(opts?)
(opts?: CourseSearchOptions) → Course[]
Search the in-memory course catalog. Options: query (free-text across code/title/description), subject (restrict to one subject code), attributes (must carry ALL listed NUPath codes), minSH/maxSH, term (offered in this semester type), limit (default 20). Ranking: exact code → code prefix → title prefix → substring.
getCourse(courseId)
(courseId: string) → Course | null
Look up one course by stable id (e.g. "CS3500"). Returns null if not found.
getOfferedIn(courseId)
(courseId: string) → OfferedInEntry[]
Complete offering history ordered newest-first. Each entry has termCode, label ("Spring 2025"), semTypeId, year, and offered (boolean — false means confirmed not offered, not just unknown). Returns [] if no history scraped for this course.

Programs

listPrograms()
() → ProgramOption[]
All available majors, minors, and concentrations as a flat list. Use the returned id values as programId in auditRequirements().
auditRequirements(programId, plan)
(programId: string, plan: PlanContext) → Promise<Program>
Audit a plan against one program's full requirement tree. Returns the tree annotated with satisfaction status, creditsNeeded, and creditsDone at each node. Throws if programId is unrecognized. Async because major JSON files are lazily loaded.

Active plan

getPlan()
() → PlanContext
Complete snapshot of the currently active plan. Includes placements, work experience, program selections, substitutions, placed-out courses, bonusSH, credit totals, violation counts, offering overrides, and the currently selected course. The adapter reads live React state from PlannerContext.
listPlans()
() → PlanListEntry[]
All saved plans — active plan first. Each entry has id, name, active. Use SWITCH_PLAN in IPlannerAction to change the active plan.

Derived reads

getNUPathCoverage(plan?)
(plan?: PlanContext) → AttributeCoverage[]
NUPath attribute coverage for a plan. If plan omitted, reads the live active plan. Returns one entry per attribute code in the institution's grid, ordered to match the grid layout. Each entry has code, label, satisfied, and satisfiedBy (course IDs and work term IDs that grant the attribute).
checkPrereqs(courseId, completedIds)
(courseId: string, completedIds: string[]) → PrereqCheckResult
Check whether a course's prerequisites are met. completedIds should include all placed, placed-out, and incoming course IDs. Returns { satisfied, missing, concurrent } — concurrent prereqs are not counted as missing. Pure function, no live state.

Dry-run

validateChangeset(actions, plan?)
(actions: Action[], plan?: PlanContext) → ChangesetValidation
Apply a sequence of actions to a copy of the plan and return the result — without touching real plan state. Returns { valid, violations, resultingPlan }. resultingPlan is a full PlanContext after the changes — Claude can reason about the outcome before proposing. If plan is omitted, starts from the live active plan.

PlanContext — the canonical plan snapshot

Defined in IPlannerQuery.js, imported by IAIAssistant and IPlannerAction. This is everything a serializable snapshot of one plan needs:

FieldTypeDescription
planId, planNamestringActive plan identity
major, concentration, minor1, minor2string (path id)Program selections — raw path ids. Empty string if not set.
majorLabel, minor1Label, minor2Labelstring | nullHuman-readable resolved labels, e.g. "Computer Science, BS"
currentSemId, entSem, entYear, gradSem, gradYearstring / numberTimeline — current semester marker, entry, and graduation
placementsObject<courseId → semId>Where each course is placed. Special semId "incoming" = Incoming Credit section (AP/transfer).
semOrdersObject<semId → courseId[]>Display order of courses within each semester
workExperienceObject<instanceId → WorkTermEntry>Co-ops, internships, etc. (labelled "WORK EXPERIENCE" in UI; internally specialTermPl)
placedOutstring[]Course IDs marked as placed-out (satisfy prereqs, earn no credit)
substitutions{from, to}[]Placed from also satisfies requirements of to
bonusSHnumberBonus / incoming general credits not tied to a specific course (AP, transfer test-out)
shOverridesObject<courseId → number>Per-plan SH overrides for variable-credit courses
offeredOverridesObject<courseId → {semTypeId → boolean}>User-forced offering status overrides. true = force offered, false = force not offered. Absent = auto.
totalSHPlaced, totalSHDonenumberDerived totals (all placed + bonusSH; completed semesters + bonusSH)
prereqViolationCount, coreqViolationCountnumberViolation counts — use checkPrereqs for details
selectedCourseIdstring | nullCurrently highlighted course in the UI

IPlannerAction — all action types

Actions are plain objects with a type discriminant, grouped by concern:

Course placement

TypeRequired fieldsNotes
ADD_COURSEcourseId, semIdMoves corequisites automatically. Removes placed-out flag if set.
REMOVE_COURSEcourseIdRemoves corequisites that are only placed because of this course.
MOVE_COURSEcourseId, toSemIdMoves corequisites with it.
ADD_PLACED_OUTcourseIdMarks as placed-out; removes from semester if currently placed.
REMOVE_PLACED_OUTcourseIdDoes not auto-place; course becomes unplaced.
ADD_SUBSTITUTIONfromId, toIdPlacing from also satisfies requirements of to. Credits count once.
REMOVE_SUBSTITUTIONfromId, toId

Work Experience

TypeRequired fieldsNotes
ADD_WORK_TERMtypeId, semId, durationOptional: company, companyDomain, subline. Adapter validates slot fit.
REMOVE_WORK_TERMinstanceId
MOVE_WORK_TERMinstanceId, toSemIdRe-validates placement rules at new location.
UPDATE_WORK_TERMinstanceIdOptional: company, companyDomain, subline. Updates metadata without moving.

Programs and settings

TypeRequired fieldsNotes
SET_MAJORprogramIdPass empty string to clear. programId from IMajorRequirements.getMajorOptions().
SET_CONCENTRATIONlabelFreeform string, not a path id. Pass empty string to clear.
SET_MINOR1programId
SET_MINOR2programId
SET_BONUS_SHamountReplaces current bonusSH entirely.
SET_SH_OVERRIDEcourseId, valuevalue: null to clear override. Ignored for fixed-credit courses.
SET_OFFERED_OVERRIDEcourseId, semTypeId, statusstatus: true = force offered, false = force not offered, null = auto (clear override).
SET_ENTRYsem, yearEntry semester and year; may trigger sticky-course remapping.
SET_GRADUATIONsem, year
SET_CURRENT_SEMsemIdMoves the "in progress" marker. semId must be valid in SEMESTERS list.

Multi-plan management

TypeRequired fieldsNotes
CREATE_PLANnameNew empty plan becomes active after creation.
RENAME_PLANplanId, name
SWITCH_PLANplanIdCurrent plan auto-saved before switching.
DELETE_PLANplanIdRequires confirmDestructive: true on the Changeset. Cannot delete the last plan. Adapter rejects without the flag regardless of execution mode.

UI commands (no plan mutation)

TypeRequired fieldsNotes
FOCUS_COURSEcourseId (or null)Select (highlight) a course as if the user clicked it. Triggers prereq/coreq line drawing and opens info panel. Pass null to deselect.
OPEN_SEARCHqueryOpen the course bank with a pre-filled search query. Switches to "all" tab and focuses the input.
SET_BANK_TABtabSwitch bank tab. Valid values: "all", "placed", "starred".

Changeset structure

// A named, ordered batch of plan mutations
{
  actions:            Action[],   // ordered, applied atomically
  rationale:          string,     // shown to user in review UI — 1-3 sentences
  label:              string,     // headline, e.g. "Restructure Fall 2025"
  confirmDestructive: boolean,    // required true to include DELETE_PLAN
}

All actions in a changeset are validated and applied atomically — either all succeed or the whole batch is rejected.

Result types

propose() → ProposeResult

{ status: 'queued' | 'rejected', proposalId?: string, reason?: string }

Returns immediately — does not wait for the user to review. proposalId can be used to reference the pending proposal. reason is only present when status === 'rejected' (e.g. missing confirmDestructive flag). Per-action violations appear in the review UI, not here.

apply() → ApplyResult

{ status: 'applied' | 'partial' | 'rejected', appliedCount, totalCount, violations, reason? }

violations are violations present in the resulting plan — non-empty does not necessarily mean the apply failed (a move may introduce a prereq warning the user will resolve later). status: 'partial' means some actions succeeded before an error; the successful ones were still applied and pushed to undo.

✦
Dry-run first: Always call validateChangeset(actions) before propose() or apply(). It costs nothing (no state mutation) and gives Claude full visibility into violations and the resulting plan state before the user sees anything.
